purpose: SCAN terminal-acceleration fix (evaluateAcc(t) -> evaluateAcc(time)) for a new materialized build

rationale.defect: Polynomial initialization supplies the acceleration at the last sample strictly before the polynomial end as the terminal acceleration.
time_is_true_end: planner_manager.cpp:124 declares `double time`, the requested polynomial duration, in the enclosing block.
planner_manager.cpp:128 builds one segment of duration `time` with end acceleration Eigen::Vector3d::Zero().
planner_manager.cpp:141-143 builds two segments of `time / 2` each (total `time`) with end acceleration Zero().
planner_manager.cpp:155 samples `for (t = 0; t < time; t += ts)` and line 167 applies `t -= ts`, so `t` is the last sample, strictly before `time`.
planner_manager.cpp:169 already supplies the requested end velocity, local_target_vel, not a sampled value.
planner_manager.cpp:242 (previous-trajectory branch) already supplies a zero end acceleration.
traj_utils/include/traj_utils/polynomial_traj.h:131-139 evaluateAcc(t) locates the segment with a 1e-4 s tolerance, so evaluateAcc(time) evaluates the last segment at its end.
rationale.unchanged: No limit, gate, deadline, optimizer setting or sampling step is changed.
rationale.upstream_divergence: The base file hash equals the pinned PCT-SCAN-ROS2 base (1cf45a1c). This build diverges from that base by this line only; an unmodified official build was not verified.
